items.question: How do I set up the base station initially?
items.answer: Place the base station in an open location with good Wi-Fi signal, removing any objects closer than 1.5 m from the front and 5 cm from either side. Insert the power cord into the base station firmly upwards until the indicator turns on, then plug it into a socket and turn the switch to I (ON). It's recommended to place the base station on tile or marble floors to prevent water stains on wood floors or carpets.

...

items.question: How do I turn the robot on and off?
items.answer: To turn on the robot, press and hold the power button for 3 seconds until the power indicator illuminates. The robot will also turn on automatically when placed on the base station. items.question: How do I clean the dust box and filter?
items.answer: Open the robot cover and press the dust box clip to remove the dust box. Open the dust box cover, remove the filter, and empty the dust box. Gently tap the filter basket to remove dirt. Rinse the dust box and filter with clean water only (no detergent), then dry them completely for 24 hours before reinstalling. Do not clean the filter with a brush, finger, or sharp objects.

3. Gently tap the basket of the filter to remove the dirt.
4. Rinse the dust box and filter with water and dry them completely before reinstalling. (Requires 24h drying time)

**Note:**
* Do not attempt to clean the filter with a brush, a finger or sharp objects to prevent damage.

items.question: What safety precautions should I follow regarding the battery?
items.answer: Do not use third-party batteries or base stations; only use with model RCXE0307/RCXE0307-5 base station. Do not disassemble, repair, or modify the battery. Do not place the base station near heat sources. If not using for an extended period, fully charge the robot, turn it off, and store in a cool, dry place. Recharge at least once every 3 months to prevent over-discharging. Dispose of old batteries at appropriate recycling facilities.

items.question: What is the Do Not Disturb mode and how does it work?
items.answer: In Do Not Disturb (DND) mode, the robot is prevented from resuming cleaning and the power indicator goes out. It's disabled by default at the factory. You can enable it or modify the DND period in the app; the default period is 22:00-8:00. Scheduled cleaning tasks will still be performed during DND, and the robot will resume cleanup after the DND period expires.
items.sourcePassage:
When the robot is set to the Do Not Disturb (DND) mode, the robot will be prevented from resuming cleaning and the power indicator goes out. The DND mode is disabled by default at the factory. You can use the app to enable the DND mode or modify the DND period. The DND period is 22:00-8:00 by default.

**Note:**
* The scheduled cleaning tasks will be performed as usual during the DND period.
* The robot will resume cleanup where it left off after the DND period expires.

items.question: How do I clean the washboard on the base station?
items.answer: Enable washboard base cleaning in the app and the robot will exit automatically. Remove the washboard and wait for water to fill the base. Use the cleaning tool to clean the washboard base, then the station will pump out used water. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Flip the washboard, remove the roller cover and roller, pull off end caps, remove tangled hair, and reassemble by matching colors. Rinse the washboard with clean water, wipe it clean, and reinstall it downwards in an inclined way into the base station.
items.sourcePassage:
1. Enable the washboard base cleaning function in the app, and the robot will exit the base station automatically. Take out the washboard and wait for water to fill the washboard base.
2. Use the cleaning tool to clean the washboard base. After a moment, the base station will automatically pump out the used water. Then wipe the washboard base with a soft and dry cloth.
3. Flip the washboard over, remove the roller cover and the roller in turn, and then pull off the end caps of the roller. (Note: If the roller cover is blocked by wipers on both sides of the washboard, rotate the roller to move them aside.)
4. Remove the hair tangled in the roller, and then reassemble the parts according to corresponding colors, as shown in the figure below.
5. Rinse the washboard with clean water, wipe it clean and then put it back into the base station downwards in an inclined way.
6. Use the app or briefly press the dock button on the robot to make it return to the base station.

items.question: What are the different cleaning modes available?
items.answer: The robot offers several cleaning modes: Vacuum and Mop (default when mop assembly is installed), Mop after Vacuuming (robot removes mop assembly to vacuum first, then reinstalls it to mop), Vacuum Only (robot removes mop assembly and vacuums), and Mop Only (robot installs mop assembly if needed and mops with main brush and side brush raised). These modes can be selected in the app.
items.sourcePassage:
**Note:** When using the mop assembly for the first time, the robot performs the "Vacuum and Mop" task by default.
...
### Mop after Vacuuming
Enable the mopping after vacuuming function in the app, and the robot will automatically remove the mop assembly on the base station to vacuum the floor. After vacuuming is completed, the robot will return to the base station to install the mop assembly and the base station will automatically start emptying the dust box. And then, the robot will start mopping after the main brush and side brush are raised.

### Vacuum Only
Enable the vacuuming function in the app, and the robot will automatically remove the mop assembly on the base station and start vacuuming.

### Mop Only
Enable the mopping function in the app, and the robot will automatically check if the mop assembly is installed on the base station. If not, the robot will install the mop assembly and start mopping after the main brush and side brush are raised.
